༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa la rigs gsum las/dang po zhe sdang gi rtog rigs so gsum ni/yul mi 'dod pa'i rnam pa can la shas chung

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa la rigs gsum las/ dang po zhe sdang gi rtog rigs so gsum ni/ yul mi 'dod pa'i rnam pa can la shas chung ngu 'doṃd chaṃgs daṃng bralaṃ baṃ dang / 'bring 'doṃd chagasaṃ dngaṃ bralaṃ baṃ baṃr maṃ dang / chen po shinaṃ tuṃ 'doṃd chaṃgs daṃng bralaṃ baṃ dang / nang gi yul la tshur 'jug pa gaṃng yiṃd kyiṃ 'oṃng baṃ dang / phyi'i yul la phar 'gro ba yiṃd kyiṃ 'groṃ baṃ dang / yul gyi rjes su soṃng baṃ dang / yul yid du 'ong ba dang bral ba'i gdung ba chung ngu myaṃ nganaṃ dang / 'bring myaṃ ngaṃn b.raṃ maṃ dang / chen po shinaṃ tuṃ myaṃ nganaṃ dang / sems rnal du 'dug pa'i dal ba zhiṃ baṃ dang / sems rgod pa rnamaṃ paraṃ rtogaṃ paṃ dang / yul yid du mi 'ong ba dang phrad nas sems skrag pa chung ngu 'jiṃgs paṃ dang / 'bring 'jiṃgs paṃ b.raṃ maṃ dang / chen po shinaṃ tuṃ 'jiṃgs paṃ dang / yul la zhen pa tha ma sreṃd paṃ dang / 'bring sreṃd paṃ b.raṃ maṃ dang / rab shinaṃ tuṃ sreṃd paṃ dang / 'dod yon gyi yul la kun tu 'dzin pa nyeṃ b.raṃ lenaṃ paṃ dang / dge ba'i las la yid gnyis za ba miṃ dgeṃ baṃ dang / zas dang skom 'dod pa bkresaṃ skomaṃ dang / bde sdug btang snyoms gsum la yul gyi sgo nas chung ngu tshoraṃ baṃ dang / 'bring tshoraṃ baṃ b.raṃ maṃ dang / chen po shinaṃ tuṃ tshoraṃ baṃ dang / yul shes pa riṃg paṃ dang / rig par bya ba'i las riṃg paṃ 'dziṃn pa'iṃ gzhiṃ dang / rigs pa dang mi rigs pa dpyod pa soṃ soraṃ rtoṃg paṃ dang / chos rgyu mtshan du byas nas kha na ma tho ba la 'dzem pa ngoṃ tshaṃ sheṃs paṃ dang / dmigs bya sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa chung ngu brtseṃ baṃ dang / 'bring brtseṃ baṃ b.raṃ maṃ dang / chen po shiṃn tuṃ brtseṃ baṃ dang / yid 'phrig pa'i sems nges par mi gnas pa dgoṃs paṃ dngaṃ bcaṃs paṃ dang / yo byad sog par 'dod pa sdudaṃ paṃ dang / yo byad kun tu 'dzin pa seraṃ snaṃ rnams so/

/gnyis pa 'dod chags kyi rtog rigs bzhi bcu ni/ thob zin gyi yul la chags pa 'doṃd chaṃgs paṃ dang / ma thob pa'i yul la chags pa chaṃgs paṃ dang / yul yid du 'ong ba mthong nas sems dgaṃ' baṃ chung ngu dga' ba dang / 'bring dgaṃ' baṃ b.raṃ maṃ dang / chen po shiṃn tuṃ dgaṃ' baṃ dang / 'dod don 'grub sems bde ba raṃngs paṃ dang / de'i rnam pa sems kyis yang dang yang du myong ba raṃb tuṃ mguṃ baṃ dang / gtam sna tshogs pas 'di ci yin nam min snyam du the tshom za ba ngoṃ mtshaṃr baṃ dang / yid du 'ong ba mthong nas sems g.yeng ba rgoṃd paṃ dang / bde ba'i rnam pa myong ba tshimaṃ paṃ dang / 'khyud par 'dod pa 'khyudaṃ paṃ dang / 'o byed par 'dod pa 'oṃ byedaṃ paṃ dang / lus kyi cha shas 'jib par 'dod pa'i 'jiṃb paṃ dang / rgyud mi 'gyur ba brtaṃn paṃ dang / dge ba la gzhol ba brtsonaṃ 'grusaṃ dang / mtho bar sems pa kheṃngs paṃ dang / bya ba rdzogs par byed pa byedaṃ paṃ dang / nor 'phrog par 'dod pa 'phroṃg paṃ dang / gzhan gyi dpung 'joms par 'dod pa stoṃbs dang / dge ba'i lam la goms par byed pa sproṃ baṃ dang / yul la 'bad pa'i sbyor ba chung ngu tshamaṃ tshoṃm meṃd paṃ dang / 'bring tshamaṃ tshoṃm meṃd paṃ baṃr maṃ dang / chen po shiṃn tuṃ tshamaṃ tshoṃm medaṃ pa dang / rgyu med par yang dam pa rnams dang rtsod par 'dod pa dreṃgs paṃ dang / yid 'ong mthong bas 'gying ba rnamaṃ paṃr sgeṃg paṃ dang / 'khon du 'dzin pa 'graṃs paṃ dang / dge ba'i las la rtsol bar 'dod pa dgeṃ baṃ dang / gzhan gyis go bar smra 'dod pa tshiṃg gsaṃl baṃ dang / 'du shes ma bsgyur bar smra 'dod pa bden paṃ dang / 'du shes bsgyur te smra 'dod pa miṃ bdeṃn paṃ dang / yi dam shin tu brtan pa ngesaṃ paṃ dang / yul yongs su 'dzin par mi 'dod pa nyeṃ b.raṃ miṃ lenaṃ paṃ dang / bdog pa gtong bar 'dod pa sbyinaṃ paṃ poṃ nyid dang / gzhan le lo can bskul bar 'dod pa brtulaṃ ba dang /

dgra las rgyal bar 'dod pa dpa'aṃ baṃ dang / mi dge ba bcu la mi 'dzem pa ngoṃ tshaṃ baṃ medaṃ paṃ dang / bcos mas gzhan bslu ba g.yoṃ canaṃ dang / lta ba ngan pa la zhen pa gdugaṃ paṃ canaṃ dang / gzhan la tho 'tsham pa mi srun pa dang / rgyud mi drang ba gyaṃ gyuṃ cheṃ baṃ rnams so/ /gsum pa gti mug gi rtog rigs bdun ni/ don du gnyer bya'i ngo bo ji bzhin mi shes pa 'dodaṃ chaṃgs bar maṃ dang / dran pa nyams pa brjeṃd ngeṃs dang / smig rgyu la chur 'dzin pa sogs 'khruṃl paṃ dang / smra snying mi 'dod pa miṃ smraṃ baṃ dang / yid sun pa skyoṃ baṃ dang / dge ba la mi spro ba leṃ loṃ dang / las 'bras dang chos nyid la yid gnyis za ba theṃ tshoṃm rnams so/ /spyir rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su len pa la gnad 'di bzhin shes dgos te/ dpal mchog dang po'i rgyud las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug ste/ /gsum po 'di rnams dug chen yin/ /dug nyid kyi ni rten byas nas/ /dug tu nye bar 'gro ba nyid/ /bdud rtsi nyid du rten byas na/ /bdud rtsi nyid du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la/ slob dpon klu byang gis rim lnga'i 'grel pa nor phreng las/ 'dir ni don 'di yin te/ 'dod chags ni dga' ba'i rnam grangs dang ldan pa'i snang ba'o/ /zhe sdang ni bral ba'i rnam pa dang ldan pa'i snang ba nye bar thob pa'o/ /gti mug ni snang ba gsal ba'i rnam grangs dang ldan pa'i mchog ste de rnams ni 'od gsal ba'i de kho na nyid bzhi pa mthong ba 'jig rten gyi dug dang mtshungs pa'i dug yin te/ dug bzhin du gsod par byed cing 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung bar byed pa yin no/ /dus nam zhe na gang gi tshe de rnams dug nyid kyis te rnam par rtog pa nyid kyis bsten cing nyams su myong bar byas pa de'i tshe dug nyid du nye bar 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /yang gang gi tshe bdud rtsi nyid kyis te de kho na nyid bzhi pa'i skad cig tu shes pas brten cing ro gcig par byas pa de'i tshe dpal rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur bas bdud rtsi nyid du 'gyur ro/

/zhes gsungs la/ de'i don ni kun nas nyon mongs pa'i chos 'di rnams bla ma dam pa brten nas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba legs par ngo 'phrod tshe bde ba chen po'i ye shes su gnas 'gyur zhes pa'i don yin la/ des na rang lugs kyi gsang dbang zhu ba'i tshe bla ma yab yum gyis bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu mgrin pa nas myang bas lus thams cad la khyab ste rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa dbyings su dag cing gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye zhes pa'i don kyang de bzhin du go dgos la/ spyir gsang 'dus kyi gzhung rnams las sems dang yid dang rnam shes zhes pa 'jug shes drug dang nyon yid dang / kun gzhi'i rnam shes rnams yin la/ 'chi ba'i tshe de gsum rim bzhin 'gag pa na dkar lam/ dmar lam/ nag lam gsum 'char ba la snang mched thob gsum du grags shing / de'i dus su zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rtog pa so gsum dang / 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rtog pa bzhi bcu/ gti mug las gyur pa'i rtog pa bdun rim bzhin 'gag pa la rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gag zer ba yin la/ des na snang mched thob gsum zhes pa don gyis 'jug shes nyon yid kun gzhi'i rnam shes rnams yin pas gtso sems dang / rang bzhin brgyad cu zhes pa sems byung yin la/ rang lugs kyi 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba legs par ngo 'phrod na sems las phyi rol du gyur pa'i chos med pas/ snang ba gsum dang rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa dbyings su dag tshe 'khor ba'i chos ma lus pa bde chen gyi ye shes su ngo 'phrod pa yin pa'ang shes dgos so/ /lar rang bzhin gyi skad dod la swa bha wa zer ba yin la/ de bod skad du bsgyur na/ 'byung ba dang / dngos po dang / rang bzhin rnams la 'jug pas/ gang du drangs kyang gtub mod/ 'dir grub chen klu'i byang chub kyis/ rang bzhin brgyad cu zhes pa'i don sems byung brgyad cu la ngos 'dzin mdzad 'dug pas/

de bzhin go ba gnad du che/ 'di zhib tu shes par 'dod na grub chen klu byang gis mdzad pa'i rim lnga'i 'grel pa nor phreng dang / kha che'i mkhas pa chen po dpal lakṣ+mīs mdzad pa'i rim pa gsal byed sogs la blta bar bya'o/ /rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa tshan gsum po 'di yul ha cang mi 'dod pa dang / ha cang 'dod pa dang / bar ma gsum gyi sgo nas 'jug pa'i rigs gsum du 'du ba'i sgo nas 'chad rgyu yin par bod kyi bla ma snga ma rnams kyis gsungs 'dug /sga ston rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang legs pas mdzad pa'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sga ston ngag dbang legs pa/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
